books.name: Flagship

thesis_full.summary: IWM is the mechanical leadership sleeve holding — the 96.8th percentile sector ETF by 252-day relative-strength, trend-confirmed above its 200-day moving average. Size is equal-weight within the leadership budget (0%).
thesis_full.why_now: IWM ranks in the 96.8th percentile for 12-month RS and clears the 200-day trend gate, making it the doctrine's 'present in the leader mechanically' expression — holding the sector without chasing the single name underneath.
bear: Leadership rotation: held ONLY while RS stays top-decile (currently 96.8th percentile) — exits mechanically if RS drops below the 70th percentile; no discretion.
Breadth / narrowing risk: sector ETF performance can be driven by a handful of mega-cap names; if underlying breadth narrows the ETF masks single-name concentration risk.
Extension vs 200-day MA unknown (no stockdata for this ETF) — assume normal mean-reversion risk applies; monitor pct_vs_200dma.
Mechanical sleeve: no single-name conviction here; macro de-risk (regime quad flip or liquidity-overlay) trims the leadership budget first — exits are systematic, not qualitative.
thesis_full.what_would_prove_wrong: IWM breaks below its 200-day moving average for 3+ consecutive sessions, or drops below the 70th RS percentile relative to the sector universe.
thesis_full.sizing_rationale: Leadership sleeve: equal-weighted across the trend-gated top RS sectors. Weight = 0% (sleeve budget ÷ number of qualifying leaders). No confluence gate required; the trend filter is the only gate.
